chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about how Allah perceives the world?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to elucidate the concept of *al-Nazar al-Salih* (perceiving the good), illustrating that Divine perfection entails viewing all creation through the lens of ultimate wisdom. This principle serves as a cornerstone for Shia theological optimism, affirming that even apparent evils are encompassed within Allah’s comprehensive knowledge and benevolent decree.
